claim: Cisco's observability team spent 5 months engineering the migration from self-managed Kafka to Amazon MSK and then implemented the new stack in 6 weeks.

evidence.quote: The observability team spent 5 months engineering the migration from self-managed Kafka to Amazon MSK and then implemented the new stack in 6 weeks.
As part of an initiative to improve its existing processes, Cisco’s observability team decided to look for a solution to increase the performance of its stack by removing the required maintenance.
